active_question: How should we talk about the Vitality Chew?
positioning: Flagship product launching The Dogist wellness line
Designed for daily use with subscription at the core
audience_jobs: Help me give my dog more good years without feeling like I am falling for pet-wellness hype.
Help me understand what is in this and why it is safe for my specific dog.
Help me add something healthy to my dog's routine that my dog will actually eat.
Help me feel proactive without implying this replaces my vet or medicine.

brand_guardrails.text: Beautiful design that people love having on the countertop

trust_constraints: Do not imply the chew prevents disease, cures medical conditions, or extends lifespan.
Do not use grief, rescue, or senior-dog stories as direct purchase hooks without extra care.
Do not frame the product as a substitute for veterinary guidance.
Do not overstate the comment corpus as validated demand.
Do not write generic superfood copy that could come from any pet brand.

deck_context.brand_promise: The Dogist deepens the loving relationship you have with your dog.
deck_context.target_insight: Dogs make our lives better, so we owe it to them to make theirs longer, healthier, and happier.
deck_context.brand_essence_statement: The Dogist products help you show love to your dog by connecting you with research-backed recipes and a voice you can trust to help your dog live a better life.
